info.title: BulletinLab API V1
info.description: Socle contractuel intérimaire de l'API V1 sur le schéma actuel. L'authentification, le profil courant, les conventions transversales, l'archivage contrôlé d'une classe, les attributions contrôlées de cours et de titulariat, l'archivage et la réactivation contrôlés d'un élève, la sortie historisée d'une inscription, la lecture composée du bulletin, les résumés contextuels de bulletins, l'aperçu individuel déterministe et non officiel du calcul, les lectures contextuelles des notes et de leur historique, les invitations d'appartenance et l'onboarding public sont décrits. L'emailing des invitations reste un différé applicatif. Les autres contrats scolaires définitifs restent différés jusqu'à la validation des identifiants publics.

get.summary: List pending and historical invitations of the current establishment
get.description: Management-only paginated list of membership invitations scoped to the establishment and tenant of the authenticated token. The raw token is never returned and cannot be replayed from the list.

post.summary: Invite a new member into the establishment
post.description: Creates a pending invitation for one email and one tenant-visible role. The returned token is displayed exactly once; only its SHA-256 digest is stored. Creating a second active invitation for the same email conflicts with 409. Cross-tenant and super-admin roles are not resolvable.

delete.description: Marks the invitation revoked. Replaying the command on an already revoked invitation returns the same state without another audit entry. Revoking an accepted invitation conflicts with 409. Invitations are scoped to the authenticated tenant and establishment.

post.summary: Accept an invitation and onboard a membership
post.description: Public onboarding with no bearer token. The invitation token is carried in the request body so it never appears in logs or URLs. Identity attributes come from the payload but the email always comes from the invitation. A token is single-use: only accept once while pending. Rate limited per IP and per token.

204.description: The current access token was revoked.
The current platform access token was revoked.

get.summary: List the current teacher's effective course assignments
get.description: Transitional current-schema read. The authenticated active teacher sees only their own assignments that are effective on the current business date in an active class, open school year and active report-card model of the current establishment. Historical, future, expired and inactive assignments are excluded.

get.summary: List the current assignment's grade entry slots
get.description: Transitional current-schema read. A slot is temporarily represented by the positive maximum linking the assigned course node to an active, writable model period. Locked periods remain visible and explicitly deny entry.

get.summary: Read the grade sheet for one current assignment slot
get.description: Transitional current-schema read. The sheet paginates active enrollments and includes students without a result as note null. Encoded results expose SAISIE, ABSENTE or DISPENSEE, plus the lock_version required for a later correction; only SAISIE carries a value. A locked slot remains readable and explicitly denies entry.

post.summary: Import grades into one current assignment slot
post.description: Transitional current-schema write. Accepts one UTF-8 comma-delimited CSV file or one XLSX workbook with at most 1000 data rows. Headers matricule,note and matricule,note,statut_resultat create results or replay identical state. Add a final lock_version column when changing an existing result; it must match the version returned by the grade sheet. Assignment, slot, class, course, period, tenant and actor are resolved server-side. The complete file is validated before any write; one invalid or stale row rolls back notes, history and progress. A global correction reason is required only when an existing result changes. An identical replay performs no write.

put.summary: Create or correct one grade in a current assignment slot
put.description: Transitional current-schema write. Assignment, slot, enrollment, report card, course, period, tenant and actor are resolved server-side. The optional status defaults to SAISIE; SAISIE requires a bounded value while ABSENTE and DISPENSEE require no value. A real status, value or comment correction requires the current lock_version and a reason, increments the version atomically and appends one history revision. A stale correction returns 409. Replaying the same normalized result and comment performs no write or version increment.

get.summary: List grades for the current establishment
get.description: Management-only paginated list. Teachers and class titulars use their contextual views.
Available to establishment management, the exact class titular, or the teacher holding the single current assignment for the grade slot.

get.summary: List grades for an authorized class
get.description: Paginated list available to establishment management and the exact class titular.
Paginated newest-first history under the same contextual authorization as the grade.

Available to establishment management and the exact class titular, including for an archived class. The report card, enrollment, student, class and annual model must share the current establishment context.

get.summary: Preview one deterministic report-card period calculation
get.description: Management-only, read-only preview over one coherent locked database snapshot. This current-schema result is neither persisted nor official. It refuses missing grades, non-SAISIE result statuses, non-MATIERE nodes, invalid maxima and coefficients other than 1.00 instead of silently inventing calculation rules.

get.summary: List authorized report-card summaries for one class
get.description: Stable newest-first pagination for establishment management and the exact class titular. Assigned course teachers cannot read complete report cards. Archived classes remain readable.

post.summary: Archive a class without deleting academic history
post.description: Sets active to false when the class has no active enrollment. Report cards, grades, attendance, assignments and final enrollments remain unchanged. Replaying the command on an archived class returns the same state without another audit entry. This is state idempotence, not Idempotency-Key support.

get.summary: List the configured courses of one class
get.description: Transitional current-schema read. Courses are represented by MATIERE ModeleNode records from the exact class report-card model. Only management or the exact current class titular may read the collection. Archived classes remain readable for historical consultation. Teachers use the dedicated /me/attributions contract.

put.summary: Assign the current course to one teacher
put.description: Transitional current-schema command. The course is represented by a MATIERE ModeleNode and will be replaced by coursClasse in the target schema. A different active teacher is deactivated atomically. Replaying the same teacher and dates returns the same assignment without another audit entry or event.

put.summary: Assign the current titular to one class
put.description: Transitional current-schema command. The historical titular assignment and the operational classes.titulaire_id pointer are written atomically. A previous active assignment is closed before the new one is created. Replaying the same titular and dates returns the existing assignment without another audit entry or event. Database-enforced active uniqueness remains deferred.

post.summary: Archive a student without deleting academic history
post.description: Sets actif to false when the student has no active enrollment. Replaying the command on an archived student returns the same state without another audit entry. This is state idempotence, not Idempotency-Key support.

post.summary: Reactivate a student without altering academic history
post.description: Sets actif to true without creating an enrollment or changing report cards, grades and attendance. Replaying the command on an active student returns the same state without another audit entry. This is state idempotence, not Idempotency-Key support.

post.summary: Record an enrollment exit without deleting academic history
post.description: Transitions an active enrollment to ABANDON or EXCLU. The report card, grades and attendance history are preserved. On the current schema, date_sortie and motif are retained in the audit log. Replaying the same final status returns the same state without another audit entry or event; this is not Idempotency-Key support.

get.summary: Compose the report card attached to an enrollment
get.description: Returns the configured nodes, periods and grading slots. Missing grades are represented by note: null and no empty note row is created.

post.summary: Publish one report-card period calculation as the official persisted result
post.description: Locks the annual model and the period, then runs the deterministic engine and resolves the mention and the decision from the configured scale. Persists an immutable calculation snapshot, creates the official publication, mirrors the result onto the live report card and writes a BULLETIN_PUBLIE audit entry only for a new publication. Replaying the command on unchanged results reuses the same immutable snapshot and publication and writes no extra audit entry.

post.summary: Rectify a published report-card period result with a mandatory motif
post.description: Recomputes the deterministic engine, forces a new immutable snapshot and a new official publication, marks the current publication as RECTIFIEE and records the correction with its mandatory motif. Writes a BULLETIN_RECTIFIE audit entry. Rejects the command when no published result exists for the report card and period.

post.summary: Generate or replay the class proclamation for a period
post.description: Builds the proclamation and its ranked lines from the published bulletins of the class and period that already have a pourcentage and a proposed decision. Returns the existing proclamation when one was already generated and not canceloed, without duplicating it. Writes a PROCLAMATION_GENEREE audit entry only when a new proclamation is created. This is state idempotence, not Idempotency-Key support.

post.summary: Délibérer la classe pour une période
post.description: Valide la décision finale de chaque bulletin publié de la classe et de la période. Les bulletins déjà délibérés sont ignorés. Écrit une entrée d'audit BULLETIN_DELIBERE par bulletin délibéré. Il s'agit d'une idempotence d'état, pas d'un support Idempotency-Key.

post.summary: Publier les bulletins de la classe pour une période
post.description: Publie officiellement chaque bulletin de la classe et de la période. Les bulletins déjà publiés sont comptés comme déjà publiés et ne sont pas dupliqués. Il s'agit d'une idempotence d'état, pas d'un support Idempotency-Key.

post.summary: Générer la promotion de la classe pour une période
post.description: Construit la promotion annuelle et la liste des promotions d'élèves à partir des bulletins délibérés et publiés de la classe et de la période. Retourne la promotion déjà générée lorsqu'une existe. Il s'agit d'une idempotence d'état, pas d'un support Idempotency-Key.

get.description: Retourne l'année scolaire globale active correspondant à la date du jour (septembre à juillet).

post.description: Crée ou réactive l'ouverture annuelle locale de l'établissement pour l'année scolaire donnée ou la plus récente. Idempotent : renvoie l'état déjà ouvert.
Marque l'ouverture annuelle comme clôturée. Retourne l'ouverture déjà clôturée. Écrit une entrée d'audit OUVERTURE_ANNUELLE_CLOTUREE lors de la première clôture.

role_id.description: Tenant-visible role identifier. Super-admin roles are never assignable.

token.description: One-time raw invitation token. Never sent in URLs or logs.
One-time raw token returned only by this response and only its SHA-256 digest is stored.

statut_resultat.description: Defaults to SAISIE when omitted. ANNULEE is read-only and cannot be selected by a teacher.

valeur.description: Required for SAISIE and null or omitted for ABSENTE and DISPENSEE. The selected slot maximum is enforced dynamically.

motif_correction.description: Required by the server only when an existing grade is changed. Ignored for a creation or an identical replay.

lock_version.description: Required only for a real correction. It must equal the current version returned by note reads. An identical replay may carry an older version and still performs no write.

file.description: CSV or XLSX file, maximum 2 MiB. Supported headers are matricule,note, matricule,note,statut_resultat, matricule,note,lock_version and matricule,note,statut_resultat,lock_version. lock_version is required per row only for a real correction. note is required for SAISIE and empty for ABSENTE or DISPENSEE.

motif_correction.description: One reason applied to every real correction in the batch. Required by the server only when an existing grade changes.

date_sortie.description: Must be within the enrollment school year and not precede date_inscription.

attribuable.description: True when at least one strictly positive grading maximum is configured.

public_id.description: Public scoped identifier of the platform user.

publication_ready.description: True only when this preview is calculable and both its period and annual model are locked. It does not mean that an official publication exists.

code.description: Stable machine-readable domain error code when one is available. Optimistic note concurrency conflicts use NOTE_VERSION_CONFLICT.
